Markets.title: Trump administration's embrace of "perp" futures sets off risk alarms for Wall Street stalwarts
Markets.summary: The Trump administration's launch of perpetual futures has raised concerns among traditional Wall Street exchange leaders. These established figures argue that the new offerings could disrupt current market dynamics and should be classified as swaps.

Markets.title: US dollar dips as easing AI and Mideast worries limit its appeal
Markets.summary: The US dollar fell from a six-month high following strong job growth data and easing global concerns. Investors are now watching upcoming consumer price index figures to gauge potential Federal Reserve interest rate decisions.

Markets.title: US stocks: Dow Jones rallies 500 points, Nasdaq over 2% as chip stocks rebound; Nvidia probe weighs
Markets.summary: U.S. stocks rallied, with the Dow Jones jumping 500 points and the Nasdaq gaining over 2% as chip stocks rebounded. Despite Nvidia shares declining due to an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang, other tech giants and chip manufacturers experienced substantial gains.

Markets.title: Nvidia sell-off continues: Chipmaker stock plunges 9% as Jensen Huang faces espionage controversy
Markets.summary: Nvidia shares plunged 9% after the company opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with an executive linked to intelligence efforts. Investors are concerned over security risks and uncertainty surrounding Huang's future leadership.

Markets.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: Dow rockets 1,200 pts after last week's tech-led rout; oil prices swing
Markets.summary: The Dow Jones surged 1,200 points following a severe technology-led market sell-off last week. Meanwhile, crude oil prices experienced significant fluctuations during the trading session.

Markets.title: India bonds continue rally ahead of inflation data
Markets.summary: Indian government bond yields fell nearly 4 basis points on Monday, driven by lower crude oil prices and optimism surrounding a potential US-Iran peace deal. Investors are currently awaiting upcoming US and Indian inflation data to gauge future interest rate trends.

Geo-Political.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
Geo-Political.summary: France has accused Iran of orchestrating a cyberattack that caused refrigeration systems in hundreds of supermarkets to fail last month. This incident resulted in the spoilage of tons of chilled and frozen food.

Geo-Political.title: Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
Geo-Political.summary: Nvidia shares tumbled following an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's alleged affair with a Chinese spy. The resulting drop in stock price wiped hundreds of billions of dollars from the company's market value.

Geo-Political.title: Trump questions midterm elections integrity after previously accepting results
Geo-Political.summary: Donald Trump questioned the integrity of the upcoming midterm elections on Truth Social on Monday. He made these claims without providing any evidence.

Geo-Political.title: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people
Geo-Political.summary: An explosion at the Habas Demir Celik steel factory in Aliaga, Turkey, killed at least 17 people. Eyewitnesses reported that the blast was powerful enough to shake the ground, initially leading some to believe an earthquake had occurred.

Geo-Political.title: Republican congressman to force impeachment vote on Defence Secretary Hegseth
Geo-Political.summary: Republican Representative Thomas Massie plans to force an impeachment vote against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Massie aims to pressure President Trump into firing Hegseth before Democrats can initiate their own impeachment proceedings.

Geo-Political.title: Nine Zimbabweans caught allegedly trying to leave South Africa to fight in Ukraine
Geo-Political.summary: South African authorities intercepted nine Zimbabwean nationals who were allegedly attempting to leave the country to fight in Ukraine. This incident follows claims by Ukraine that hundreds of individuals from various African nations have been recruited to fight for Russia.

Data & Insights.summary: Indian exporters are preparing to utilize new free trade agreements to improve their global market presence. However, past trade pacts failed to significantly boost exports and instead increased India's trade deficit.

Data & Insights.title: Fertilizer availability comfortable for rabi sowing, stock position exceeds requirement across key nutrients
Data & Insights.summary: Despite early shortages and delayed sowing, India enters the rabi season with comfortable fertilizer stocks that exceed requirements across key nutrients. This supply buffer is supported by annual fertilizer subsidy spending that has exceeded ₹2.17 trillion.

Data & Insights.title: India's forex reserves fall $2.69 billion to $717 billion: Why RBI is selling dollars and what it means for the rupee
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves dropped by $2.69 billion to $717.06 billion in the week ending October 30, driven by central bank dollar sales and asset valuation changes. The Reserve Bank of India is actively selling dollars to manage market volatility and protect the rupee's valuation against depreciation pressures.

Data & Insights.title: Iran war: IOC to buy crude, LPG carriers as Strait of Hormuz disruptions drive freight costs
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Oil Corporation plans to purchase crude and LPG carriers and explore domestic shipbuilding to counter rising freight costs caused by Strait of Hormuz disruptions. This initiative supports the company's broader strategy to diversify crude supplies, build inventories, and strengthen its energy supply chain.

Data & Insights.title: The midterms give Fed more room to raise rates, mut maybe less reason to do so
Data & Insights.summary: Midterm election results suggest a slowdown in datacenter spending. This reduction in spending could help curb inflation and influence future Federal Reserve interest rate decisions.

Data & Insights.title: No fresh curbs on broken rice exports as India banks on steady paddy procurement
Data & Insights.summary: India exported 8.08 lakh tonnes of broken rice in calendar year 2025 after lifting a previous export ban on March 7, 2025. The government has decided not to impose any fresh restrictions on broken rice exports due to steady paddy procurement.

India.title: "Does Haryana's Smoke Go To Pak, Punjab's To Delhi?" AAP Hits Back At BJP
India.summary: The Aam Aadmi Party responded to the BJP regarding Delhi's severe pollution crisis by questioning the direction of agricultural smoke. This exchange highlights the escalating political confrontation between the two parties over the capital's worsening air quality.

India.title: Sonia Gandhi Recalls 'Indira's Tears' Over Op Blue Star, Akali Dal Hits Back
India.summary: Sonia Gandhi recently recalled Indira Gandhi's grief over Operation Blue Star. In response, Akali Dal criticized the Congress leadership, stating that the military operation was a direct attack on the Sikh community and Sri Akal Takht Sahib.

India.title: Haryana Chief Minister Attacks Bhagwant Mann Over Alleged Drinking Habit
India.summary: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini has urged the people of Punjab to help Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann overcome his alleged drinking habit. Saini's remarks follow a similar allegation made by Congress leader Rahul Gandhi at a rally in Sangrur.

India.title: 2 Critical, 3 Injured After Government Buses, Car Collide In Mumbai
India.summary: Two government buses and a car collided in Mumbai, leaving two people in critical condition and three others injured. Police used a crane to clear the damaged vehicles and rescue the occupants from the scene.

India.title: Delhi Boy Beaten To Death By Man For Bursting Crackers Near His Son
India.summary: A boy was beaten to death in Delhi's Punjabi Basti after bursting firecrackers near another person's son. Police are investigating the incident which occurred in the Baljeet Nagar area.

India.title: 6 Of Family Die As Fire Engulfs House, Attached Store On Diwali In Maharashtra
India.summary: Six members of a family died when a fire engulfed their house and attached grocery store in Maharashtra at midnight on Diwali. The blaze completely destroyed the property, reducing it to ashes.

General.title: Russell Brand sentenced to 10-and-a-half years in prison for rape and sexual assault
General.summary: Comedian and actor Russell Brand was sentenced to 10 and a half years in prison following his conviction for rape and sexual assault. A Southwark Crown Court jury found him guilty after a four-week trial.

General.title: Brand's ex Jemima Goldsmith accuses him of violence and abuse against her
General.summary: Jemima Goldsmith has accused her ex-partner, Russell Brand, of violence, coercive control, and abuse during their relationship. The allegations add to a growing list of misconduct claims against the disgraced performer.

General.title: What happened inside court as Brand was sentenced

General.summary: Civil servant Kashim Chowdhury was convicted of fraud after secretly working five jobs simultaneously. He stole £284,000 of taxpayers' money over a three-year period.
